content.value_statement: Ceiling choices can reduce room height, hide maintenance problems, or waste budget. This skill provides practical, room-specific planning guidance from a large Chinese reference library.
actual_capabilities: Compares suspended ceilings, simple trim, and exposed ceiling options for different rooms.
Recommends kitchen and bathroom materials with moisture, ventilation, and maintenance considerations.
Explains ceiling height, proportions, layouts, and common construction details.
Identifies prerequisites for demolition, waterproofing, electrical work, ventilation, cabinets, and curtain boxes.
Adapts recommendations to room size, household needs, budget, and project stage.
limitations: The Chinese reference library reflects China-specific construction practices and examples.
The skill cannot inspect structures or replace licensed designers, engineers, electricians, or contractors.
Reliable recommendations require accurate dimensions, utility locations, budget, and household needs.
Costs, building codes, product specifications, and material availability require local verification.

use_cases.title: Choose a ceiling approach
use_cases.description: Compare ceiling and no-ceiling options for a room with clear benefits, drawbacks, and prerequisites.

use_cases.title: Review construction details
use_cases.description: Check proposed heights, materials, lighting, ventilation, waterproofing, and cabinet interfaces before work begins.

use_cases.title: Prepare contractor questions
use_cases.description: Turn renovation concerns into a focused checklist for quotations, material selection, sequencing, and site acceptance.

prompt_templates.title: Decide whether to add a ceiling
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether my [room] needs a ceiling. Dimensions: [dimensions]. Budget: [budget]. Give a direct recommendation and key risks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare ceiling materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [material A] and [material B] for my [room]. Prioritize moisture resistance, maintenance, height loss, cost, and installation requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Create a coordinated plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ceiling plan for [home details]. Cover heights, lighting, ventilation, curtain boxes, cabinets, sequencing, budget, and contractor checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a proposed design
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this ceiling design: [proposal]. Identify conflicts with structure, utilities, waterproofing, cabinets, codes, and maintenance. Rank fixes by urgency.

output_examples.input: My old apartment has a 2.5-meter ceiling. Should I install a full suspended ceiling?
output_examples.output: Recommendation: avoid a full suspended ceiling. Use local concealment only where pipes or equipment require it, and keep the remaining ceiling visually simple.

output_examples.input: Compare aluminum panels and moisture-resistant gypsum board for a bathroom ceiling.
output_examples.output: Aluminum panels favor access and moisture tolerance. Gypsum board offers a seamless finish but needs careful waterproofing, ventilation, access panels, and qualified installation.

best_practices: Provide room dimensions, ceiling height, utilities, budget, and photos when available.
Confirm structural changes, property rules, waterproofing, electrical safety, and local codes with qualified professionals.
Use recommendations as a contractor checklist and verify material specifications before purchase.
anti_patterns: Do not approve demolition based only on a photo or general description.
Do not select a ceiling style before checking ducts, pipes, windows, cabinets, and lighting.
Do not treat historical examples or quoted costs as current local prices.

faq.question: What topics does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers ceiling choices, materials, dimensions, lighting, ventilation, waterproofing, cabinets, balconies, kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living rooms.

faq.question: Are the source references in English?
faq.answer: No. The source library is Chinese, but the skill can summarize recommendations in the requested language.

faq.question: Can it produce construction drawings?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning guidance and checklists, not stamped drawings, engineering calculations, or site measurements.

faq.question: Can it help with low ceilings?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare no-ceiling, local concealment, trim, and shallow ceiling options based on available height.

faq.question: Does it provide exact project costs?
faq.answer: No. It can explain cost drivers and priorities, but local contractors must provide current quotations.

faq.question: Does it replace professional safety review?
faq.answer: No. Structural, electrical, gas, waterproofing, and code decisions require qualified local professionals.
